Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in traffic on a Houston roadway when the vehicle behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear
of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was accompanied by a Passenger at the time of impact.
Officers confirmed that both occupants were present in the vehicle at the scene, and the Passenger's presence is
supported by statements taken at the location. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy for the
damaged vehicle.
The damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid, and tail lamp assembly of Driver 1's car is consistent with the impact
described by both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details, including the final
resting positions of the vehicles. A few older scratches are visible on the rear panel, and it is not certain whether
these predate this collision. No independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of the
parties and the physical evidence.
It is not yet clear whether the knee injury reported by Driver 1 resulted from this crash. Medical records have not been
reviewed, and the matter remains open pending further information.
